# Sprout

> Sprout is an offline-first maths training game that turns short daily practice
> into real skill. It offers 18 maths skill games, Rapid Fire timed speed rounds,
> difficulty that adapts to you, honest progress diagnostics, a Mistake Notebook
> with spaced-repetition review, and structured Learning Journeys. It works fully
> offline and requires no account or sign-up.

## Key facts
- Category: Maths training game / education / brain training
- Audience: Learners aged 13–60
- Platforms: iOS and Android (coming soon)
- Price: Free core game; optional Premium with monthly, yearly and lifetime plans ($3.99/month)
- Privacy: Offline-first, data stored locally on device, no ads, no trackers, no data selling
- Account: Not required — the app is account-free, with no login or email screen

## Core features
- 18 skill games: Cross Math, Mental Sprint, Multiplication, Division, Powers and Roots, Number Sequences, Equation Builder, Missing Number, Fractions, Percent and Money, Ratio and Proportion, Order of Operations, Algebra, Geometry, Logic Grid, Estimation, Word Problems and Math Riddles
- Rapid Fire: mixed-difficulty timed rounds (30s, 60s, 90s or two minutes); focus one skill or all
- Adaptive difficulty and Smart Workout: 12-question sessions built around your weak skills
- Honest diagnostics: accuracy, response time, XP, levels, practice streaks and per-concept mastery, all from real answers
- Mistake Notebook: wrong answers saved with the correct method, resurfaced as reviews on day 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30
- Learning Journeys and achievements: six structured journeys and eight progressive achievements
- Placement assessment sets your starting level and daily practice goal

## Premium (monthly / yearly / lifetime)
Everything in Free, plus Expert difficulty, longer Rapid Fire sessions, Smart Workout,
detailed skill diagnostics, the Mistake Notebook, premium colour themes and future
puzzle packs. Billed via the app store.
